Usage: sink db [OPTIONS] {put|pull|diff} SERVER [SQL_GZ]

  Overwrite a db with a gzipped sql file.

  ACTION: pull or put.
  SERVER: server name (defined in util.yaml).
  SQL-GZ: gzipped sql file to upload.  Required if action is "put".

  When pulling, a gzipped file name is created using the project name, the
  server name, the date and time.  It is created in the pulls_dir.  eg:

  pulls_dir/projectname-servername-20-01-01_01-01-01.sql.gz

Options:
  -t, --tag TEXT  Add a tag to the generated filename when pulling.
  -r, --real
  -q, --quiet     Return only the filename
  -h, --help      Show this message and exit.
